checks.test: valid mixed-scope archives and planned URLs are verified without network access
project hydration preserves CRLF, Unicode, binary and zero-length content
production scope hydrates only production members
project verification does not require unrelated production archive bytes
CLI success receipt is created once and an existing receipt is never overwritten
default hydration refuses an existing destination without writes
explicit merge reuses identical files and preserves unrelated files
all merge conflicts are preflighted before any new member is written
corrupt archive digest is rejected before destination creation or success receipt
member hash mismatch is rejected even when archive checksum matches
manifest traversal, absolute/drive/backslash/ADS/reserved/noncanonical/Git-metadata paths are rejected
unsafe ZIP path is rejected independently of a safe declared manifest
ZIP symbolic links are rejected
duplicate physical ZIP members are rejected
case-colliding physical ZIP members are rejected
duplicate restoration paths across same-scope archives are rejected
identical relative paths are allowed only across separate restore scopes
file-versus-directory prefix conflicts are rejected
case-colliding directory prefixes are rejected
unexpected archive members are rejected
declared archive over 1 GiB is rejected without allocating a large fixture
existing junction/symlink parent is rejected before writes outside the target
existing directory case conflicts are rejected without writes
explicit ZIP directory entries are rejected by the regular-files-only schema
